# Business Model Innovation

## When to use
Use when the task requires invent differentiated online income opportunities grounded in real customer problems and deliverability.

## Procedure
Combine independently validated buyer pains with capabilities, channels, local language/market advantages and AI. Produce unique positioning hypothesis, delivery blueprint, biggest unknown, minimal falsification test, and payout check request. Avoid made-up demand and generic side-hustle lists.

## Mandatory handoff
Return: input/assumptions, steps completed, dated evidence or local record IDs, confidence, blockers, quality checks, next action. If required evidence or permission is missing, stop and mark UNVERIFIED or BLOCKED rather than guessing.

## Safety
No financial commitment, account registration, external outreach, false identity, geographic restriction bypass, or publication without explicit user approval. Avoid leaking credentials or private data.
